I love the TDQS system. I've personally revised my MCPs to improve the quality of the score... Really love the idea behind this and Glama in general.

After uploading a new MCP version, the quality score test wouldn't rerun for 3 days despite manual resyncs and API attempts. Turned out a credit card was required for rebuild/release to work, which wasn't documented; adding a few dollars in credits fixed it and score jumped to A.

Neither I nor my AI agent could figure out over 4 days of searching documentation why the quality score retest wasn't triggering on the latest MCP version, even though the page showed updated README and release info.
